# Divider

`layout/divider` &middot; content-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

A horizontal rule between content components, styled by the theme.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Full-width hairline in the theme divider style.
- **short**: A short centered rule. Sets `width: 48px`, `thickness: 2px`.
- **dashed**: A dashed line. Sets `style: dashed`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `thickness` | length | `"@theme.divider.width"` |
| `style` | one of `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted` | `"@theme.divider.style"` |
| `color` | color | `"@theme.divider.color"` |
| `width` | length | `"100%"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solid lines are honored. Dashed and dotted can render as solid. | Fine. | Border color swaps via dm-border when it uses the brand border color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/divider', {}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "layout/divider",
  "data": {}
}
```
